title: Guta Rinotenda Munguva
intro: Munhoroondo dzetsitsi dzaMwari, mune nzanga ine nguva yekuchinja kwayakaita yaive nguva yekuzadzikiswa kwezvose. Wava kuda kuburitsa nyaya yavo—nyaya yekuyambira, kupfidza, uye kuzorora inovasiyanisa neramangwana remamwe marudzi.
clues: Taiva vanhu vakatumirwa nhume, uye takarega kudanwa kwake pakutanga.
Zviratidzo zvekurangwa kwaiuya pazvakava pachena, takaona chokwadi chenyevero yake.
Takatendeukira kuna Ishe wedu nekutendeuka kwechokwadi, uye kutenda kwedu kwakagamuchirwa.
Chirango chakanga chapihwa kwatiri chakabviswa nekuda kwekutenda kwedu.
Nyaya yedu inotaurwa seyakasiyana pakati pemaguta akatenda mushure mekuona chirango.
Taiva vanhu vemuporofita akamedzwa nehove hove, asi takaponeswa kubva mukuparadzwa.
verse: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time. (37:148)
